note: Spec instance for scripts/realdata_gate_analysis.py --spec --paired on the counterfactual-absence fixture cut_roasted_beef_absfix_60_89. Version 1.2.0 freezes the anchors (A=60, B=89, CA=230, CB=259) and folds in the 2026-09-10 Codex review (research-wiki/operations/absence-fixture-lane-2026-09-10.md, section 5): B is the LAST ABSENT frame; the claim floor is the fixed PAIRED_MIN_EFFECT_DB rather than |U - GONES| (G-ones is a late-gap sham with a real code-path cost, not a null arm); only P1 carries a verdict; the operative verdict is read from the mechanism-exercised set; sham and G-est pairs are required on every G-U prefix; every P1 frame must carry a non-empty core mask; reserved units must be reported by every cell; the mechanism predicate requires zero-presence frames inside the P1 window and the bottle box at frame 75; sizing is informational. The comparison remains DESCRIPTIVE at n = 4 pairs.
event_bbox_note: every BOTTLE_* event in absfix/absence_event_masks.json carries the same cam00 box [964, 748, 1035, 953] (half-open), the union silhouette over the gap padded by 8 px; per-frame PSNR on that box is available on every frame, so the endpoints below read their windows from BOTTLE_absence_gap

anchor_semantics.A: first absent frame (the first frame on which the object is gone from the imagery)
anchor_semantics.B: LAST absent frame (the object is back on frame B+1). Version 1.1.0 wrote 'first frame of the return'; with that reading B would be 90 and every window would shift by one. The expressions below assume B = last absent frame.
anchor_semantics.CA: first frame of the control window
anchor_semantics.CB: last frame of the control window
anchor_semantics.expressions: a window edge is an integer or '<anchor>+<n>' / '<anchor>-<n>', resolved once by the loader

arm_roles.G: gated on the truth membership (construction masks) with the authored gap [60, 89] (the intervention under test)
arm_roles.GEST: gated on the ESTIMATED membership (DEVA ids) with T1's frozen gap [60, 91]. On this fixture the construction masks were derived from the same DEVA silhouettes, so the estimated and truth row sets coincide exactly and G-est differs from G only by the gap
arm_roles.GMIS: truth membership, gap moved to the control window [230, 259] (sham timing)
arm_roles.GWRONGMEM: a count-matched RANDOM row set with the authored gap (sham membership; about 1% overlap with the truth set)
arm_roles.GONES: truth membership with a 12-frame gap at [286, 297], outside every scored window. An all-present program cannot be emitted (the emitter refuses gaps below 0.1667 s), so this is a LATE-GAP SHAM that exercises the gate code path, NOT a null arm: Lane A measured it as the worst arm on the return windows. Its spread against U is reported descriptively and is not the claim floor.

endpoint_notes.P1: the ghost window [63, 87], read on the per-frame cam00 core ROI (supported, eroded silhouette): the absence interior, three frames in from A and two frames short of B
endpoint_notes.P2: the clean return [92, 99] on the bounding-box event; excludes the estimator's late onset (T1 gap ends at 91), so G and G-est are compared on the same frames
endpoint_notes.S1: the settled return [100, 109] on the bounding-box event, secondary
endpoint_notes.H1: the pre-absence harm guard [30, 57] on the bounding-box event
endpoint_notes.C1: the control window [230, 259] on the bounding-box event; no edit there; G-mis gates inside it
endpoint_notes.profile_requirement: only P1 is read from roi:core; every other region endpoint is read from the event named by 'event_name', so each cell's f_box_profile.json must be produced with BOTH --masks and --roi_dir

PAIRED_FLOOR_NOTE: the claim floor is the constant 0.5 dB (the frozen floor of the synthetic-fixture positive, +1.05 dB measured); |U - GONES| and |U - GMIS| per prefix are reported under descriptive_floors and are not verdict inputs
PAIRED_CLAIM_RULE: CLAIM_CONDITIONS_MET iff, on the mechanism-exercised set, all four G-U pairs on P1 exceed +0.5 dB AND no GMIS-U or GWRONGMEM-U pair on P1 exceeds +0.5 dB; DESIGN_WITHOUT_POWER when fewer than 4 complete U/G pairs exist or any G-U prefix lacks its GMIS, GWRONGMEM or GEST pair; NOT_MET otherwise. P2, S1, H1, H2 and C1 are descriptive. This is a pattern criterion on four pairs, not a hypothesis test.
PAIRED_VERDICT_STATUS: DESCRIPTIVE. Per-pair differences, median and range, sign consistency, the mean with a paired-t interval labelled descriptive below six pairs; no p-value, no TOST, no equivalence claim.
PAIRED_SIZING_RULE: n2_pairs = ceil(K*(sd_paired/DELTA)^2 + Z_A^2/4) on the P1 paired differences at DELTA = 0.30 dB; reported only, it does not decide a wave 2
PLACEBO: within-run diagnostic only; not an input to the paired verdict
MASK_POOLING_RULE: an event carrying kind='per_frame_mask' is pooled by MSE weighted by its pixels_per_frame; under PER_FRAME_MASK_REQUIRE_ALL_FRAMES every frame of the window must carry a non-empty mask, so no frame is ever dropped from P1
PER_FRAME_MASK_DIAGNOSTICS: for the claim endpoint the analysis also reports, per pair: the fraction of frames on which the first arm's masked MSE is lower, the count of frames with exactly zero masked error (infinite PSNR) per arm, the per-arm maximum per-frame PSNR, and the pooled MSE difference; descriptive
MECHANISM_NOTE: gate_cell_precondition.py is run with --fbox 964 748 1034 952 --fbox_frame 75 (the bottle box, inclusive, at a P1 frame); the historical field name gated_rows_fbox_frame150 then counts gated rows projecting into the bottle box at frame 75. A G, GEST or GWRONGMEM cell passes only if at least MIN_FRAMES_PRESENCE_ZERO of its zero-presence frames fall inside [63, 87]; GMIS and GONES gate elsewhere by design and are exempt from the window test but not from the count and box tests. GWRONGMEM and GONES passing means 'gate code path exercised', not 'target membership exercised'.
roi_source: scripts/event_region_frame_profile.py --roi_dir <dir>, one subdirectory per region (core/, ring/, object/), masks named <frame:05d>.png, uint8 0/255 at the render raster; each becomes an event named roi:<name> with kind='per_frame_mask'
